hypothesis: Explicit flange construction subtype verification will prevent unproved flat, loose, counter, or generic flanges from satisfying weld-neck/butt-weld requirements.
why_now: Cycle 10 was blocked by a protected-file violation before evaluation, so this high-confidence schema gap remains scientifically untested. The new plan confines changes to production code, prompt assets, and focused tests.
expected_effect: For explicit subtype queries, expose deterministic subtype evidence to reranking and return a match only for an affirmatively evidenced compatible selected candidate; preserve generic flange and non-flange behavior.
expected_metric_gain: 0–3.3 pp hard-pass coverage; primary value is reduced unsafe or unprovable selections.
lesson_from_history: Broad gating and selection changes regressed or were neutral, retrieval canonicalization plateaued, and index enrichment regressed. This is a narrow, evidence-based retry of an unevaluated schema gap, not a repeat of the Cycle 10 contract failure.
plan_summary: Created and strict-validated proposal, capability spec, design, and implementation-only tasks in openspec/changes/cycle-12-protected-flange-subtype-verification/.
